description: This file contains utility functions for content loading, semantic and text search within a repository, including parallel processing and line-by-line search, utilizing sentence transformers for semantic similarity.

methods.name: get_text_files_content
methods.description: Reads and returns content of text files in a repository directory.

methods.name: improved_search_in_repo
methods.description: Performs semantic and text-based search across files in a repository, returning sorted matches by score.

methods.name: parallel_search
methods.description: Performs parallelized search over all files in a repository for a given search string.

methods.name: search_generator
methods.description: Yields lines containing the search string from files in the repository.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Checks if a file contains the search string.

methods.name: is_valid_file
methods.description: Validates if a filename has an allowed extension.

methods.name: get_context
methods.description: Retrieves surrounding lines around a match for context.

methods.name: calculate_relevance_score
methods.description: Calculates a relevance score for a file based on content and recency.

methods.name: calculate_similarity
methods.description: Computes cosine similarity between query and content embeddings.

methods.name: get_file_recency_score
methods.description: Returns a score based on how recent the file modification date is.

methods.name: safe_search
methods.description: Wrapper for parallel search with error handling and logging.
